source_refs.note: Roman Urdu: Chapter 19 exercise hal (PDF 56-58): MCQs wajah ke saath, short, constructed response aur descriptive jawab, Kitab ki ghalti aur Wazahat boxes.

blocks.text: Yeh chapter 19 (Basics of Organic Chemistry) ki exercise hai, kitab ki tarteeb mein, hal ke saath. Har MCQ ka sahi jawab wajah ke saath diya gaya hai; short, constructed response aur descriptive sawalon ke model jawab hain. Kitab mein MCQs ki answer key nahi chhapi.
Q1. Multiple Choice Questions (MCQs): (kai jawabon mein se sahi chunein)

blocks.prompt:
I) Which of the following is organic in nature?
(In mein se kaun organic hai?)
blocks.explanation: Carbon ke kuch saada compounds riwayati tor par inorganic hain aur organic chemistry se bahar hain: carbonates, cyanides (HCN), CO₂, CO (aur CS₂). CCl₄ (tetrachloromethane) organic halogen compound (haloalkane) hai.

blocks.prompt:
II) The empirical formula of CH₃CH₂CH=CH₂ matches with:
(CH₃CH₂CH=CH₂ ka empirical formula kis se milta hai?)
blocks.explanation:
CH₃CH₂CH=CH₂ = C₄H₈ → empirical formula CH₂.
CH₃CH₃ = C₂H₆ → CH₃
CH₂=CHCH₃ = C₃H₆ → CH₂ ✓
CH₃CH₂CH₂CH₃ = C₄H₁₀ → C₂H₅
CH≡CH = C₂H₂ → CH

blocks.prompt:
III) Compounds having single bonds usually undergo reactions:
(Sirf single bonds wale compounds aam tor par kaun se reactions karte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Saturated compounds (sirf single bonds) bond tore baghair atoms add nahi kar sakte, is liye aam tor par substitution (aik atom ki jagah doosra) karte hain, maslan CH₄ + Cl₂ → CH₃Cl + HCl. Addition ke liye double ya triple bond chahiye.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Option (d) mein “substation” chhapa hai; sahi lafz “substitution” hai.

blocks.prompt:
IV) The functional group present in urea (H₂N–C(=O)–NH₂) is:
(Urea mein kaun sa functional group hai?)
blocks.explanation: Urea mein C=O group –NH₂ se jura hai, yani –C(=O)–NH₂, jo acid amide group hai. Carbonyl aur amino hisse mil kar yahi aik functional group banate hain jo alag C=O ya –NH₂ se mukhtalif bartao karta hai.

blocks.prompt:
V) Which molecule is chiral and can rotate the plane polarised light?
(Kaun sa molecule chiral hai aur plane polarised light ko ghuma sakta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Pentan-2-ol, CH₃CH(OH)CH₂CH₂CH₃: C-2 par chaar mukhtalif groups (H, OH, CH₃, C₃H₇) hain, is liye chiral hai. Baqiyon mein kisi carbon par chaar mukhtalif groups nahi (2-methylbutan-2-ol ke C-2 par do CH₃ hain).

blocks.prompt:
VI) Which carbon in CH₃CH(CH₃)CH₂CH(OH)CH₃ is chiral?
(Is compound mein kaun sa carbon chiral hai?)
blocks.explanation:
IUPAC naam: 4-methylpentan-2-ol (OH wale sire se numbering).
C-2, CH(OH), par H, OH, CH₃ aur CH₂CH(CH₃)₂: chaar mukhtalif groups → chiral.
C-4, CH(CH₃), par do CH₃ → chiral nahi. Numbering ke bare mein Kitab ki ghalti dekhein.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Jawab numbering par munhasir hai. IUPAC numbering (4-methylpentan-2-ol) se chiral carbon C-2 hai, key (b). Chhape hue formula mein baen se ginein to yeh 4th carbon hai, is liye (d) bhi kaha ja sakta hai. Sawal mein numbering wazeh honi chahiye.

blocks.prompt:
VII) In what ways could two compounds of molecular formula C₂H₂Br₂ be related to each other?
(C₂H₂Br₂ ke do compounds aapas mein kis tarah ke isomers ho sakte hain?)
blocks.explanation: C₂H₂Br₂ ya to CH₂=CBr₂ (1,1-dibromoethene) hai ya CHBr=CHBr (1,2-dibromoethene). 1,1- aur 1,2- constitutional isomers hain; 1,2-dibromoethene ki cis aur trans shakalein hain. Kisi carbon par chaar mukhtalif groups nahi, is liye optical isomers nahi.

blocks.prompt:
VIII) Which of following shows cis-trans isomerism?
(Kaun cis-trans isomerism dikhata hai?)
blocks.explanation: 2-Butene, CH₃CH=CHCH₃: double bond ke har carbon par do mukhtalif groups (H aur CH₃), is liye cis aur trans shakalein hain. Baqiyon mein double bond ke aik carbon par do aik jaise groups (=CH₂ ya =CCl₂) hain.

blocks.prompt:
IX) Which one of the following pairs do the isomers have identical boiling points?
(Kis jore ke isomers ke boiling points barabar hote hain?)
blocks.explanation: Enantiomers ki physical aur chemical properties (boiling point, melting point, density) barabar hoti hain, sirf polarized light ko ghumane ki simt mukhtalif. Cis-trans aur structural isomers ke boiling points mukhtalif hain.

blocks.prompt:
a) Define enantioers. Give enantiomers of 2-methylbutan-2-ol.
Enantiomers ki tareef karein. 2-methylbutan-2-ol ke enantiomers batayein.
blocks.explanation:
Enantiomers woh stereoisomers hain jo aik doosre ki aaina shakal (mirror image) hon aur aik doosre par poori na baithen (non-superimposable). In ki properties barabar, lekin polarized light ko barabar ulti simton (+) aur (−) mein ghumate hain.
2-Methylbutan-2-ol, CH₃CH₂C(OH)(CH₃)₂, mein koi chiral carbon nahi (C-2 par do CH₃), is liye is ke enantiomers nahi (Kitab ki ghalti dekhein). Is ka isomer 2-methylbutan-1-ol, CH₃CH₂CH(CH₃)CH₂OH, ka C-2 chiral hai (H, CH₃, C₂H₅, CH₂OH) aur is ke (+) aur (−) enantiomers hain.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: “enantioers” ghalat chhapa hai, sahi “enantiomers” hai. 2-Methylbutan-2-ol achiral hai (MCQ V mein bhi yeh achiral option hai), is liye is ke enantiomers nahi. Ghaliban koi chiral isomer, maslan 2-methylbutan-1-ol (ya butan-2-ol), murad tha.

blocks.prompt:
b) Alkanes have no functional group. Justify.
Alkanes mein koi functional group nahi. Saabit karein.
blocks.explanation: Functional group woh atom, atoms ka group ya multiple bond hai jo compound ki khaas properties tay kare. Alkanes mein sirf C–C aur C–H single (σ) bonds hain; koi polar bond, charge, double ya triple bond nahi, is liye koi functional group nahi. Isi liye yeh kam reactive hain aur hydrogen bonding nahi karte.

blocks.prompt:
c) Deduce the empirical and molecular formulae of the following compounds.
a) [drawn: a six-membered ring of single bonds]  b) [drawn: a zig-zag chain of five carbons with two double bonds, second-third and fourth-fifth carbon from the left]  c) [drawn: a four-membered ring (square) with double bonds on two opposite sides]
In compounds ke empirical aur molecular formulae nikalein.
blocks.explanation:
a) Cyclohexane (6 CH₂ ka chhalla): molecular formula C₆H₁₂; empirical formula CH₂.
b) CH₃–CH=CH–CH=CH₂ (penta-1,3-diene): molecular formula C₅H₈; empirical formula C₅H₈ (5 : 8 chhota nahi hota).
c) Cyclobutadiene (4 CH ka chhalla): molecular formula C₄H₄; empirical formula CH.

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Skeletal formula mein har kone aur lakeer ke sire par aik carbon hota hai; har carbon ke chaar bond poore karne ke liye zaroori H khud gin kar lagayein.

blocks.prompt:
d) Give systematic names of the following compounds.
i) CH₃-CH₂-CN  ii) CH₃COCH₂CH₂-CH₃  iii) CH₃CH₂COOCH₃
In compounds ke systematic (IUPAC) naam likhein.
blocks.explanation:
i) CH₃CH₂CN: propanenitrile (CN ka C mila kar 3 carbons)
ii) CH₃COCH₂CH₂CH₃: pentan-2-one
iii) CH₃CH₂COOCH₃: methyl propanoate

blocks.prompt:
e) Define electrophile and nucleophile with two examples each.
Electrophile aur nucleophile ki tareef do do misalon ke saath karein.
blocks.explanation:
Electrophile (electron pasand): naya bond banane ke liye electron pair lene wala atom ya group; positive ions ya neutral molecules, maslan H⁺, NO₂⁺ (aur Br⁺, CH₃⁺, SO₃, BF₃).
Nucleophile (nucleus pasand): naya bond banane ke liye electron pair dene wala atom ya group; negative ions ya lone pair wale neutral molecules, maslan OH⁻, NH₃ (aur CN⁻, Br⁻, H₂O).

blocks.prompt:
f) Pent-2-ene shows cis-trans isomerism but pent-1-ene does not. Give reason.
Pent-2-ene cis-trans isomerism dikhata hai magar pent-1-ene nahi. Wajah batayein.
blocks.explanation: Cis-trans isomerism ke liye double bond ke har carbon par do mukhtalif groups zaroori hain. Pent-2-ene, CH₃–CH=CH–CH₂CH₃: C-2 par H aur CH₃, C-3 par H aur C₂H₅, is liye cis aur trans bante hain. Pent-1-ene, CH₂=CH–CH₂CH₂CH₃: C-1 par do aik jaise H hain, jagah badalne se wahi molecule banta hai; cis-trans nahi.

blocks.prompt:
g) Define:
i) Constitutional isomerism  ii) Stereoisomerism
Tareef karein: Constitutional isomerism, Stereoisomerism
blocks.explanation:
i) Constitutional (structural) isomerism: molecular formula aik, lekin atoms ke jurne ki tarteeb mukhtalif, maslan ethanol CH₃CH₂OH aur methoxymethane CH₃OCH₃ (C₂H₆O).
ii) Stereoisomerism: molecular formula aur atoms ka jurna aik jaisa, lekin khala (space) mein atoms ki tarteeb (configuration) mukhtalif; is ki do qismein optical aur cis-trans isomerism hain.

blocks.prompt:
h) Define:
i) racemic mixture  ii) Optical activity
Tareef karein: racemic mixture, optical activity
blocks.explanation:
i) Racemic mixture: dextrorotatory (+) aur laevorotatory (−) enantiomers ki barabar (50 : 50) miqdar ka mixture; optically inactive hai aur (±) se likha jata hai, maslan (±)-lactic acid.
ii) Optical activity: kisi compound ki plane-polarized light ke plane ko daen (dextrorotatory, +) ya baen (laevorotatory, −) ghumane ki salahiyat; polarimeter se naapi jati hai.

blocks.prompt:
i Explain why meso tartaric acid is optically inactive although it has two chiral carbon atoms.
Meso tartaric acid do chiral carbons ke bawajood optically inactive kyun hai?
blocks.explanation: Meso-tartaric acid, HOOC–CH(OH)–CH(OH)–COOH, mein do aik jaise chiral carbons ulti configuration ke saath hain aur molecule ke beech se symmetry ka plane guzarta hai. Aik hissa doosre ki aaina shakal hai; har hissa light ko barabar ulti simt mein ghumata hai, is liye molecule ke andar hi asar khatam ho jata hai (internal compensation). Is liye yeh optically inactive hai.

blocks.text: Q3. Constructed Response Question (soch kar likhne wala sawal)

blocks.prompt:
a) A compound C₆H₅CH₃ reacts with Cl₂ in the presence of sunlight to form the product C₆H₅CCl₃.Name the mechanism of the reaction. Give its different steps.
C₆H₅CH₃ dhoop mein Cl₂ se C₆H₅CCl₃ banata hai. Mechanism ka naam aur us ke qadam batayein.
blocks.explanation:
Mechanism: free radical substitution (side chain mein), dhoop mein Cl₂ ki homolysis se.
Majmui: C₆H₅CH₃ + 3Cl₂ → C₆H₅CCl₃ + 3HCl (dhoop)
1. Initiation (aaghaz): Cl–Cl → Cl• + •Cl (dhoop, homolytic fission)
2. Propagation (silsila):
C₆H₅CH₃ + Cl• → C₆H₅CH₂• + HCl
C₆H₅CH₂• + Cl₂ → C₆H₅CH₂Cl + Cl•
Naya Cl• yahi chakkar dohrata hai aur side chain ke H aik aik kar ke badalte hain: C₆H₅CH₂Cl → C₆H₅CHCl₂ → C₆H₅CCl₃.
3. Termination (khatma, radicals jur jaate hain):
Cl• + Cl• → Cl₂
C₆H₅CH₂• + Cl• → C₆H₅CH₂Cl
C₆H₅CH₂• + •CH₂C₆H₅ → C₆H₅CH₂CH₂C₆H₅
In halaat mein ring ke H nahi badalte; yeh wahi initiation → propagation → termination rasta hai jo CH₄ + 4Cl₂ → CCl₄ + 4HCl mein hai.

blocks.prompt:
b) Draw the mirror image of each of the following compounds. Label each molecule as chiral or achiral.
i) 2-bromo-2-chloropropane  ii) 1-bromo-1-chloroethane  iii) ethoxyethane  iv) 2-aminopropanoic acid
Har compound ki aaina shakal (mirror image) banayein aur chiral ya achiral batayein.
blocks.explanation:
Aaina shakal banane ka tareeqa: markazi carbon ko chaar groups ke saath 3D mein banayein (do plane mein, aik wedge aage, aik dash peechhe), phir wahi molecule aaine mein dekha hua banayein, yani daen baen ulat.
i) 2-bromo-2-chloropropane, (CH₃)₂CBrCl: C-2 par do aik jaise CH₃; aaina shakal ghuma kar asal par baith jati hai → achiral.
ii) 1-bromo-1-chloroethane, CH₃CHBrCl: C-1 par H, CH₃, Br, Cl (chaar mukhtalif) → chiral; molecule aur us ki aaina shakal enantiomers ka jora hain.
iii) Ethoxyethane, CH₃CH₂–O–CH₂CH₃: kisi carbon par chaar mukhtalif groups nahi aur symmetry ka plane hai → achiral.
iv) 2-Aminopropanoic acid, CH₃CH(NH₂)COOH: C-2 par H, CH₃, NH₂, COOH → chiral; do enantiomers.

blocks.prompt:
c) What is the alkane of lowest relative molecular mass that contains a chiral centre? Give its systematic name and molecular formula. Also draw mirror image of this compound.
Sab se kam relative molecular mass wala alkane jis mein chiral centre ho: naam, molecular formula aur aaina shakal.
blocks.explanation:
Chiral carbon ke liye chaar mukhtalif groups chahiye; alkane mein sab se chhota set H, CH₃, C₂H₅ aur C₃H₇ hai, jis ke liye 7 carbons chahiye.
Naam: 3-methylhexane, CH₃CH₂CH(CH₃)CH₂CH₂CH₃
Molecular formula: C₇H₁₆ (Mr = 100); C-3 chiral hai (H, CH₃, C₂H₅, CH₂CH₂CH₃).
Aaina shakal: C-3 ko H, CH₃, C₂H₅ aur C₃H₇ ke saath 3D mein bana kar aaine mein ulat dein: dono shakalein aik doosre par nahi baithteen (enantiomers).
(2,3-Dimethylpentane, yeh bhi C₇H₁₆, ka C-3 bhi chiral hai.)

blocks.prompt:
d) 3-chlorobutan-2-ol is an optically active compound. Draw all its possible optical isomers. Is there any meso form of this compound? Give reason.
3-chlorobutan-2-ol ke tamam optical isomers banayein. Kya is ki meso shakal hai? Wajah dein.
blocks.explanation:
CH₃–CH(OH)–CH(Cl)–CH₃ mein do chiral carbons hain: C-2 (H, OH, CH₃, CHClCH₃) aur C-3 (H, Cl, CH₃, CH(OH)CH₃).
Optical isomers = 2ⁿ = 2² = 4.
Zanjeer ko seedha khara banayein (oopar CH₃, phir C-2, C-3, neeche CH₃), H aur doosra group dono taraf:
Isomer 1: C-2 par OH daen, C-3 par Cl daen
Isomer 2: OH baen, Cl baen (1 ki aaina shakal)
Isomer 3: OH daen, Cl baen
Isomer 4: OH baen, Cl daen (3 ki aaina shakal)
Yani enantiomers ke do jore: (1, 2) aur (3, 4).
Meso shakal: nahi. Meso ke liye do aik jaise chiral carbons chahiye taake molecule ka aik hissa doosre ki aaina shakal ho. Yahan C-2 par OH aur C-3 par Cl hai, dono hisse kabhi aik jaise nahi, kisi isomer mein symmetry ka plane nahi, aur chaaron optically active hain.

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Optical isomers ki zyada se zyada tadaad 2ⁿ hai (n = chiral carbons). Agar do chiral carbons bilkul aik jaise hon (jaise tartaric acid) to aik meso shakal ban kar tadaad kam ho jati hai; yahan aisa nahi.

blocks.prompt:
Q4. Explain the difference between homolytic and heterolytic fissions of a covalent bond.
Covalent bond ki homolytic aur heterolytic fission mein farq bayan karein.
blocks.explanation:
Covalent bond do tareeqon se toot sakta hai.
Homolytic fission (homolysis): jab tootne wala bond nonpolar ho. Do shared electrons barabar bat jaate hain, har atom ko aik, aur akele (unpaired) electron wale atoms ya groups bante hain jinhein free radicals kehte hain:
Cl–Cl → Cl• + •Cl (dhoop ya garmi mein)
Free radicals bohat reactive intermediates hain aur free radical mechanisms dete hain, maslan methane ki chlorination.
Heterolytic fission (heterolysis): jab tootne wala bond polar ho. Shared pair zyada electronegative atom ke paas chala jata hai jo negative ho jata hai; doosra atom positive:
CH₃–Cl → CH₃⁺ + Cl⁻
Carbon zyada electronegative atom (O, N, halogen) se jura ho to carbocation banta hai; kam electronegative metal (Li, Mg) se jura ho to carbanion. Heterolysis se electrophiles aur nucleophiles bante hain aur ionic (polar) mechanisms hote hain.

rows: Nonpolar bond mein
Polar bond mein
Shared pair barabar bat'ta hai, har atom ko aik electron
Shared pair aik atom (zyada electronegative) ke paas
Free radicals bante hain (akele electrons)
Ions bante hain: cation aur anion (maslan carbocation)
Maslan Cl–Cl → Cl• + •Cl (dhoop)
Maslan CH₃–Cl → CH₃⁺ + Cl⁻
Free radical mechanism
Ionic (polar) mechanism

blocks.prompt:
Q5. Discuss cis-trans isomerism. Explain with two examples.
Cis-trans isomerism do misalon ke saath bayan karein.
blocks.explanation:
Cis-trans isomers woh stereoisomers hain jin mein double bond ke gird ghoomne par pabandi (restricted rotation) ki wajah se groups ki khala mein tarteeb mukhtalif hoti hai (open-chain compounds).
Wajah: C–C single bond ke gird groups azaadi se ghoomte hain, lekin C=C mein aik σ bond aur p orbitals ke pehlu-ba-pehlu overlap se bana π bond hai. π bond dono sp² carbons aur un ke groups ko aik plane mein jakad deta hai; ghoomne ke liye ise torna parega (taqreeban 263 kJ mol⁻¹), jo room temperature par mumkin nahi.
Cis: do aik jaise groups double bond ki aik hi taraf. Trans: aamne saamne taraf.
Shart: molecule mein double bond ho aur double bond ke har carbon par do mukhtalif groups hon. Is liye but-1-ene (CH₂=) aur 2,3-dimethylbut-2-ene ((CH₃)₂C=) cis-trans nahi dikhate.
Misal 1: but-2-ene, CH₃–CH=CH–CH₃: cis-but-2-ene (dono CH₃ aik taraf) aur trans-but-2-ene (CH₃ aamne saamne).
Misal 2: 1,2-dichloroethene, ClCH=CHCl: cis (dono Cl aik taraf, polar) aur trans (Cl aamne saamne, dipoles khatam, non-polar).
Properties: cis aur trans ke melting point, boiling point, dipole moment, density aur heat of vaporization mukhtalif; trans cis se zyada stable.

blocks.prompt:
Q6. Describe the phenomenon of optical activity. Explain with an example.
Optical activity ka amal misal ke saath bayan karein.
blocks.explanation:
Optical activity kisi cheez ki plane-polarized light (PPL: aik hi wavelength ki roshni jo aik plane mein chalti hai) ke plane ko ghumane ki salahiyat hai. Ise polarimeter se dekha aur naapa jata hai: compound ka solution PPL ke raaste mein rakha jata hai; agar plane ghoom jaye to compound optically active hai.
Dextrorotatory (+): plane ko daen (clockwise) ghumata hai. Laevorotatory (−): baen (anticlockwise).
Shart: molecule apni aaina shakal par poora na baithe (chiral), jaise hamare daen aur baen haath. Chaar mukhtalif groups se jura carbon chiral carbon hai; aik chiral carbon wala molecule hamesha optically active hai. Jo molecules apni aaina shakal par baith jayen woh achiral aur inactive hain.
Misal: lactic acid, CH₃–CH(OH)–COOH. Markazi carbon chiral hai (H, OH, CH₃, COOH). Is ki do aaina shakalein (enantiomers) hain: (+)-lactic acid aur (−)-lactic acid. Properties barabar, lekin PPL ko barabar ulti simton mein ghumate hain; 50 : 50 mixture optically inactive racemic mixture (±)-lactic acid hai.
Optical isomers ki zyada se zyada tadaad = 2ⁿ (n = chiral carbons).

blocks.prompt:
Q7. What is the difference between racemic mixture and meso compound? Draw the structures of enantiomers and meso form of lactic acid.
Racemic mixture aur meso compound mein farq batayein. Lactic acid ke enantiomers aur meso shakal ki structures banayein.
blocks.explanation:
Racemic mixture: (+) aur (−) enantiomers ka barabar mixture; optically inactive kyun ke aik enantiomer ka asar doosra khatam kar deta hai (external compensation), maslan (±)-lactic acid.
Meso compound: aik hi stereoisomer jis mein kam az kam do aik jaise chiral carbons aur symmetry ka plane ho; optically inactive kyun ke molecule ka aik hissa doosre hisse ka asar khatam kar deta hai (internal compensation), maslan meso-tartaric acid.
Lactic acid, CH₃CH(OH)COOH, ke enantiomers (alfaz mein): chiral carbon par H, OH, CH₃ aur COOH tetrahedral tarteeb mein; aik shakal mein COOH oopar aur CH₃ neeche ho to OH daen aur H baen; doosri us ki aaina shakal, OH baen aur H daen. Yeh (+)- aur (−)-lactic acid hain.
Meso shakal: lactic acid mein sirf aik chiral carbon hai, is liye is ki meso shakal nahi (Kitab ki ghalti dekhein). Meso shakal tartaric acid, HOOC–CH(OH)–CH(OH)–COOH, ki hoti hai: dono COOH seedhe oopar neeche hon to dono OH aik hi taraf hote hain aur dono chiral carbons ke beech se symmetry ka plane guzarta hai.

rows: Do compounds ka mixture: (+) aur (−) enantiomers barabar (50 : 50)
Aik hi compound (aik stereoisomer)
Bahar se cancel (external compensation): aik molecule doosre ka asar khatam karta hai
Andar se cancel (internal compensation): molecule ka aik hissa doosre ka asar khatam karta hai
Do active enantiomers mein alag kiya ja sakta hai
Active shakalon mein alag nahi hota
Aik chiral carbon se bhi mumkin, maslan (±)-lactic acid
Kam az kam do aik jaise chiral carbons aur symmetry ka plane chahiye, maslan meso-tartaric acid
(±) se likha jata hai
Molecule mein symmetry ka plane hota hai

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Lactic acid, CH₃CH(OH)COOH, mein sirf aik chiral carbon hai, is liye is ki meso shakal ho hi nahi sakti; yeh sirf (+) aur (−) enantiomers aur un ke racemic mixture ki shakal mein hai, jaisa chapter khud kehta hai. Meso ke liye kam az kam do aik jaise chiral carbons chahiye; chapter ki misal tartaric acid hai, jis ki meso shakal jawab mein bayan ki gayi hai.
